def main(employee: str, personal_message: str) -> dict:
	emp = frappe.get_doc("Employee", employee)
	to_email = emp.personal_email or emp.company_email or emp.user_id
	if not to_email:
		frappe.throw(f"Employee {emp.name} has no email on file.")

	template = frappe.get_doc("Email Template", "Onboarding Welcome")
	context = {
		"employee": emp,
		"portal_link": frappe.utils.get_url("/onboarding-documents"),
		"personal_message": personal_message,
	}
	subject = frappe.render_template(template.subject, context)
	message = frappe.render_template(template.response, context)

	frappe.sendmail(
		recipients=[to_email],
		subject=subject,
		message=message,
		now=True,
		reference_doctype="Employee",
		reference_name=emp.name,
	)
	return {"sent_to": to_email, "subject": subject}
description: Sends the 'Onboarding Welcome' email to a newly created Employee, with a short personal message and a link to the document-upload portal. Call this exactly once, after the Employee record exists. `personal_message` should be 2-4 warm sentences built only from facts already gathered about this hire (role, department, start date) — never invent details. Returns the recipient address and rendered subject.
